parsed.english: For every language L ⊆ {0,1}* that lies in NP, there is a polynomial-time computable map f on bit strings such that every x in L is sent to a YES instance of the binary syndrome decoding promise problem, and every x not in L is sent to a NO instance.
parsed.why_clearer: It removes the Bool-valued `decide` wrapper around a classical proposition and shows the plain statement: every NP language admits a polynomial-time promise reduction to the syndrome decoding problem.
